items.title: Cilium 1.20 Expands Gateway API and Opens eBPF Datapath for Kubernetes
items.blurb: Cilium 1.20 has been released with broader Kubernetes Gateway API support, an extensible eBPF datapath and further work on sidecarless mutual TLS.

items.title: Microsoft Previews dotnetup: Toolchain Manager for .NET SDKs and Runtimes
items.blurb: Microsoft has released a public preview of dotnetup, a cross-platform toolchain manager that installs and updates .NET SDKs and runtimes in the user’s own directory without admin rights.

items.title: Announcing Amazon ECS Gateway, a managed ingress solution for your ECS services
items.blurb: AWS announces Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) Gateway, a new resource that simplifies ingress networking for containerized applications by dynamically provisioning and managing Application Load Balancers (ALBs) and their…

items.title: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support disassociating replicas
items.blurb: Amazon DynamoDB global tables now support disassociating a replica without deleting its table or data. Global tables provide fully managed, multi-Region, multi-active replication.

items.title: Polly Generative engine upgraded with more natural speech, 14 new voices, and 2 new languages
items.blurb: Today, we are introducing a new model behind the Amazon Polly Generative engine that delivers more natural-sounding, accurate speech output with low latency.

items.title: AWS announces TorchNeuron: Native PyTorch Support for AWS Trainium (Public Beta)
items.blurb: Today, AWS launched the public beta of TorchNeuron, an open source native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium.

items.title: Structured outputs for Claude models available on Amazon Bedrock
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs for all Anthropic Claude models across both the bedrock-runtime and the bedrock-mantle endpoint.

items.title: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source
items.blurb: AWS Clean Rooms now supports Databricks as a data source , so collaboration members and their partners can securely analyze data managed in Databricks without moving or revealing the source data.

items.title: Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release
items.blurb: PHP is a popular general-purpose scripting language that powers everything from your blog to the most popular websites in the world.
